- Initial release of go-elevenlabs skill.
- Provides a typed Go client for the ElevenLabs REST API using oapi-codegen.
- Supports operations like listing voices, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, sound effects, dubbing, and fetching user info.
- Includes setup and usage instructions, with examples for authentication and calling endpoints.
- Emphasizes API key security and notes that only REST API endpoints are supported (not WebSocket).
